title: Count Subarrays With Fixed Bounds
goal: Count subarrays whose minimum is minK and maximum is maxK.
strategy: Track the latest out-of-range value and latest occurrences of both required bounds. For each end, valid starts lie after the barrier and no later than the earlier bound occurrence.
